subject: E-Commerce
title: The Multi-Channel Seller
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Multi-Channel Seller.

hook.text: Top sellers list on 5-7 marketplaces simultaneously. Selling on just one platform is too risky in 2024.

buildup.text: Multi-channel selling means listing the same products on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Etsy, and your own website.

discovery.text: Tools like ChannelAdvisor and Sellbrite sync inventory and orders across platforms automatically.

twist.text: Multi-channel adds complexity: different fees, policies, return windows, and customer expectations per platform.

climax.text: Diversification protects against platform dependence but multiplies operational complexity.

quiz.question: Why do top sellers list on multiple marketplaces?
options: Dependence on a single platform is too risky—diversification is a survival strategy
